entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-02-19
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Add the *ValuesFactory implementations for complex collections to the compiled model #37750
    Backlog
  • Impossible to add a migration with efcore 10 when targeting net48 #37745
  • Use of partial/filtered indexes for FK columns on TPH tables #37742
    Backlog

Closed

  • Unable to create a 'DbContext' of type 'RuntimeType'. #37748
  • NullReferenceException when running dotnet ef dbcontext optimize #36437
    10.0.4
  • ComplexProperty treated as nullable after update from EF Core 9.0 to 10.0 #37683
    10.0.4
  • Update multiple tables via navigation properties with ExecuteUpdate{Async} #37740

PullRequests

Created

  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #37749
  • [release/10.0] Fix projection of entities with complex collections through subqueries #37747
  • Route dotnet-ef diagnostic output to stderr, fix premature help exit code #37744

Merged

  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #37746
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #37701
  • Workflow to automatically add preview/rc labels for merged PRs #37737
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #37743
  • [release/11.0-preview2] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #37741

Updated

  • [release/10.0] Fix ArgumentOutOfRangeException when deleting from a complex collection with nested collections #37702
  • [release/10.0] Restore ordinals when transitioning complex collection entries from Deleted state #37729
  • [release/10.0] Fix named query filter conventions #37738
  • [release/10.0] Fix Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Tools for net8.0 #37731
  • [TINY] Use InterceptableLocation for precompiled query interceptor generation #37734
  • Implement MergeOption #36556
    community-contribution
  • Fix materialization of required complex types with all-nullable properties via LEFT JOIN #37495
  • [release/10.0] Fix InvalidCastException in OriginalValues.ToObject() with nested nullable complex properties #37703
